condition.residual_interference: Shared package and NUMA memory; hard IRQ and root kernel activity remain. No frequency, boost, SMT or IRQ changes.
condition.memory_locality: NUMA node 0 inherited; shared package and memory
condition.cadence: Sequential fresh processes; zero warmups; external identity/reservation checks and telemetry before/after each call; no inserted sleep or outcome-dependent delay.
condition.enforced: Exclusive cpuset root partition; ordinary workload exclusion; worker/controller affinities; unchanged policy checked before/after every call
condition.observed: Available CPU accounting, pressure, context switches and frequency snapshots; no kernel/IRQ or shared-package exclusion

process_accounting.scope: Whole process including setup and verification; not operation-scoped CPU consumption or per-thread productive execution.
